title: Killing the primary on purpose, in a rehearsal, before it happens for real

videos.script: A failover is a claim until a primary has died with an application running against it. The only choice is whether the first time is chosen. {{claim}} A rehearsal chooses it: a plan on paper, a number expected, and conditions that call it off. {{plan}} You write the rehearsal as a script, and test the abort first. With one node down, it refuses to start. {{abort}} Then the real run: the leader killed, the orders counted, the table checked, the node brought back. {{run}} And what the first run found, which no lesson predicted: a connection that waited for eight minutes, and would have waited for thirty. {{found}}
